nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor; used as the privileged account for ensure(), init(), batchSend(), setTradeAddress() and delegate().
Public mapping of token balances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom() and batchSend().
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve() and decremented in transferFrom().
Address allowed by ensure() to bypass sale restrictions; set by setTradeAddress().
Per-address counter of executed transfers, incremented in transferFrom() and read by condition().
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition check in ensure().
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address; set by init() and read by condition().
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap Router address that bypasses the sale condition in ensure().
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant public decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Public payable transfer() that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gatekeeper: grants unconditional pass-through to owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale holders, otherwise defers to condition().
Public payable transferFrom() that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve() that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no safety checks.
Internal view sale-limiter that rejects transfers when _saleNum, _minSale or _maxSale constraints are violated.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall into caller-supplied address a with caller-supplied calldata b.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from constructor-like parameters.
Owner-only mass distribution loop computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 hashing.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner, and granting the UNI router unlimited allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for privilege checks, allowance accounting and ownership assignment.
Raw delegatecall to arbitrary address a with arbitrary calldata b, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length that can overflow.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
Unchecked increment of the _onSaleNum[_from] sale counter.

Amount parameter _value of transfer().

Amount parameter _value of approve().

Amount parameter _value of condition().

Raw calldata parameter b of delegate().
Number-of-sales parameter saleNum of init().

Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().

Loop index i in batchSend().
Per-iteration recipient local _to in batchSend().
Address parameter addr of setTradeAddress().
Factory address parameter factory of pairFor().

Second token parameter tokenB of pairFor().

edges.reason: Parameter _to of transfer() flows into the call transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Parameter _value of transfer() flows into the delegated transferFrom call.
Parameter _from of ensure() is compared against owner, UNI and tradeAddress whitelist entries.
Parameter _to of ensure() is compared against owner in the whitelist check.
Parameter _value of ensure() is passed to condition(_from, _value).
Local _UNI computed via pairFor() is used in the whitelist comparison inside ensure().
Parameter _from of transferFrom() indexes balanceOf and allowance and is checked by ensure().
Parameter _to of transferFrom() receives the credited balance and is checked by ensure().
Parameter _value of transferFrom() drives allowance and balance mutations.
Parameter _spender of approve() becomes the allowance key.
Parameter _value of approve() is stored into allowance.
Parameter _from of condition() indexes the _onSaleNum counter mapping.
Parameter _value of condition() is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Caller-supplied address parameter a is used as the delegatecall target destination.
Caller-supplied bytes parameter b is forwarded as the delegatecall calldata.
Parameter saleNum is assigned to the _saleNum state variable in init().
Parameter token scales into _minSale in init().
Parameter maxToken scales into _maxSale in init().
Array parameter _tos drives the distribution loop and the total computation in batchSend().
Parameter _value is multiplied by the array length and credited to each recipient.
Local total is used to check and decrement the sender balance in batchSend().
Loop index i controls iteration in batchSend().
Local _to is the per-iteration credited recipient in batchSend().
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory is hashed into the CREATE2 pair derivation.
Parameter tokenA participates in the token0/token1 ordering.
Parameter tokenB participates in the token0/token1 ordering.
Local pair holds and returns the computed pair address.
Local token0 is encoded into the pair hash.
Local token1 is encoded into the pair hash.
Parameter _name is stored into the name state variable.
Parameter _symbol is stored into the symbol state variable.
Parameter _supply scales into totalSupply and the initial owner balance.
transfer() invokes the public transferFrom() implementation.
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
delegate() executes the raw delegatecall, guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom() from transfer().
msg.sender controls the allowance spender key and the allowance decrement branch in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the owner key written by approve().
msg.sender must equal owner for the delegate() privileged path to execute.
msg.sender must equal owner to call the init() configuration function.
msg.sender must equal owner to trigger the batchSend() mass distribution.
msg.sender must equal owner to change the privileged tradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes the contract owner and receives the entire supply in the constructor.
ensure() reads owner to grant unconditional whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to grant unconditional whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads the canSale mapping to grant unconditional whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads the constant UNI router address for the bypass check.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and recipient.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments the _onSaleNum[_from] sale counter.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend() reads and mutates balanceOf for the owner and every recipient.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address limits apply.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum cap.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
init() reads decimals to scale _minSale and _maxSale.
setTradeAddress() writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
The constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
The constructor writes totalSupply from the scaled _supply parameter.
The constructor writes the name state variable.
The constructor writes the symbol state variable.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath, an unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath, an unchecked addition.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
Parameter a of delegate() directly becomes the delegatecall target, letting the owner execute arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Parameter b of delegate() is passed verbatim as the delegatecall calldata.
The delegatecall executes foreign code against this contract's storage, so it can overwrite the owner state variable.
